entry.title: BIP 110: update status to closed
entry.summary:
The recent activation of the Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 110 (BIP-110 Reduced Data Temporary Softfork) marks a significant development in the Bitcoin network. As of the latest reports, two blocks at block height 961633 have successfully signaled bit 4, indicating compliance with this new protocol change. This temporary soft fork aims to address and potentially alleviate some of the data congestion issues within the network by adjusting how data is handled temporarily until the next difficulty adjustment occurs.
Furthermore, there are approximately 18,000 fully validating nodes currently operational that support this updated protocol. These nodes are crucial for maintaining the integrity and security of the blockchain while also ensuring that transactions continue to be processed and validated according to the new rules set by BIP-110. Despite the potential for increased time intervals between blocks during this adjustment phase, node operators like myself remain committed to running these fully validating nodes. This commitment helps stabilize the network and assures users that transaction processing and validation will continue as expected, albeit with possible delays until the network re-adjusts itself to the new conditions.
This update was disseminated among members of the "Bitcoin Development Mailing List" group on Google Groups, ensuring that stakeholders such as developers, miners, and investors are kept informed about critical changes affecting the network's operation and stability.
